title: The Maharashtra Tapi Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1997
full_text: The Maharashtra Tapi Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1997 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19984 Act Number: 4 Enactment Date: 1998-01-06 Act Year: 1998 Short Title: The Maharashtra Tapi Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1997 Long Title: An Act to make special provisions for promotion and operation of irrigation projects, command area development and schemes for generation of hydroelectric energy to harness the water of Tapi River pertaining to the State of Maharashtra and other allied and incidental activities including flood control in the Tapi River Valley by establishing the Tapi Irrigation Development Corporation.
